scope: Four active prospective Windows npm gaps, plus historical evidence for the removed tr46 input. Exact archive-to-installed payload binding, not final installer scope, licence certification or native binary source attestation. No package code or native addon is executed by this review.
treeDigest: Sort relative regular-file paths by code point. SHA-256 of UTF-8 path + NUL + decimal byte length + NUL + lowercase content SHA-256 + LF for every file. Symlinks and special files are rejected.
